subject: Handoff canvas: milestones, owners & risk pulses
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaprosper.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff canvas: milestones, owners & risk pulses

Elena —

Great to meet in the demo yesterday. As discussed, attaching an initial handoff canvas and a lightweight mutual action plan so we can lock owners and dates before the kickoff. High-level ask from this thread: confirm the procurement window and the SSO owner so we can schedule the technical kickoff.

Quick overview (attachment: MAP_NovaProsper_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0–2: Procurement signature & legal SOW (Owner: NovaProsper procurement)
- Week 2–4: Account provisioning, API keys, and RBAC setup (Owner: Redwood - Jonas)
- Week 3–6: SSO + SCIM integration test (Owner: NovaProsper - IT)
- Week 5–10: Pilot dataset run + quality evaluation (Owner: NovaProsper - Product)
- Week 10–12: Rollout plan and enablement (Owner: Redwood - Marissa)

Notable risks (call out):
- SSO timeline dependency: if IT requires an internal change window, SSO work may shift pilot start 2–3 weeks
- Data retention/legal: we may need to confirm retention policy during SOW sign-off (legal loop)

Please review the attached MAP and the SSO checklist (redwood-sso-integration-checklist.pdf) and reply with: 1) procurement sign-off target date, 2) SSO owner name & email, 3) any blackout/downtime windows in Aug/Sep.

Thanks — I’ll update the shared Drive link once you confirm.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0189

Thanks, Jonas — this looks good and clear. A few notes from my side: 

1) Procurement: we're aiming to finish the SOW review by Aug 20; legal is already looking at the draft you shared in the portal. I copied procurement@novaprosper.com for the formal date.
2) SSO owner: IT lead is Marco Diaz (marco.diaz@novaprosper.com). He may be on PTO Aug 12–18, which could affect early testing.
3) Pilot dataset: product will need a clean export from our staging environment; I'll put in a request for the data extract and flag any PII elements.

Can you confirm bandwidth for an integration kickoff the week of Aug 23? If Marco is available the week after his PTO (Aug 23–27) we can aim for that window.

—Elena

Elena / Marco / team —

Thanks for the quick responses and for sharing Marco's PTO window. Based on procurement target Aug 20 and Marco returning Aug 18, proposed kickoff and milestone cadence below: please ACK or suggest alternatives.

Updated mutual action plan (highlights inline):
- Procurement & SOW sign-off: target 2026-08-20 (Owner: NovaProsper - Procurement)
- Kickoff meeting (technical + success): target 2026-08-24 — agenda: SSO scoping, data export plan, success metrics (Owner: Redwood - Jonas / NovaProsper - Marco)
- Provisioning complete (API keys, service accounts): target 2026-08-31 (Owner: Redwood - Ben Carter)
- SSO + SCIM test run (1st pass): target 2026-09-10 (Owner: NovaProsper - Marco)
- Pilot run (10k queries/day sample): target 2026-09-24 — success criteria: precision >= 86% on sample prompts (Owner: NovaProsper - Product)
- Enablement & handover to CS: target 2026-10-08 (Owner: Redwood - Marissa Cole)

Contingency lanes:
- If procurement slips beyond Aug 27, we will stagger provisioning and run a dry-run with a synthetic dataset to keep momentum.
- If SSO is delayed >2 weeks, we will scope a temporary API key access model for initial pilot with stricter IP allowlisting.

Action items for this thread (please respond in-line):
1) procurement@novaprosper.com: confirm SOW target date (Aug 20?)
2) Marco: confirm you can attend the Aug 24 10:00–11:00 PT technical kickoff (meeting invite to follow)
3) Elena: confirm product contact for dataset provisioning and any known PII restrictions.

I will drop a calendar invite for Aug 24 10:00 PT and upload the MAP + checklist to the shared Drive.

Jonas
